title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 77
paragraphs: The Maeonian Cabalians, who are called Lasonians, had the same equipment as the Cilicians — what that was I shall explain when in the course of my catalogue I come to the Cilician contingent. The Milyans carried short spears, and their garments were fastened with brooches; some of them had Lycian bows, and on their heads they wore leather caps. The commander of all these was Badres son of Hystanes.
